title: Retention and deletion
rule: Trash purge is 30 days after the move. Account deletion requires an explicit confirmation, ends sessions, and removes local account rows within 30 days. A tombstone keeps the normalized email hash and the original free-week start so a new sign-in does not grant a second free week. Export and import results expire after 7 days once those jobs exist. Mail challenges expire with the 15-minute link. Provider and legal deletion are not activated; that activation waits for P09 evidence and is not claimed here.
alternatives: Delete the email hash so the free week can be granted again.
Treat a local delete as proof of provider deletion.
Keep trash until a manual purge with no deadline.
